title: Learned schema state and causal memory controls for delayed maintenance
question: Can learned finite memory reliably forecast pending cancellation and reduce physical decision cost with chosen sensing?
hypothesis: A learned 41-scalar indexed recurrent state learns a sufficient statistic; TAC memory training must beat encoder-only adaptation to support memory causality.

arms.name: schema41
arms.intervention: learn shared slot/global GRUs and encoder

arms.name: tac_reader
arms.intervention: freeze event encoder and PLM, learn reader

decision_rule.condition: All model seeds reach primary >= .80 and H512 pending/reissued at delays64/128 >= .75; active H512 failure <= .05, unnecessary service <= .10, cost <= .80; selected sensing cost does not exceed no sensing
decision_rule.licenses: Reliable development-level finite predictive control for the passing arm only

decision_rule.condition: Additionally tac_joint minus tac_encoder and tac_memory minus tac_reader are each >= .05 with paired three-seed 95% interval lower bounds > 0, and reset/swap show dependence on stored past
decision_rule.licenses: Development evidence for TAC recurrent memory training beyond event encoder adaptation
Report negative/inconclusive or baseline-only progress; no TAC memory mechanism success

interpretation_order: Validate public boundary, exact length and causal counterfactuals
Read primary pre-sensing and worst-seed long-history forecasts
Evaluate charged cost components and chosen sensing
Test memory versus encoder controls before attributing gains
held_constant: All fresh initialization; no transferred checkpoints
Matched initial tensors within TAC and schema control groups
Identical supervised current/wait/service outcomes and data across arms
Physical cost rule and observation budget
selector: Choose uninspected entity with maximum 4*p_wait*(1-p_wait); stop at score <= .1. Scores use only learned forecasts. This is an uncertainty heuristic, not learned RL or actual value of information.
train_supervision: CE on public-query current and simulated wait/service future outcomes for all eight entities; no generation labels, schema-channel labels or hidden state in forward

training_sensing.policy: common seeded random inspections for all arms
training_sensing.loss: mean of pre- and post-inspection forecast CE
